Zoe (eng-oncall): quick follow-up from the kv eviction postmortem. we agreed we need tests + owners so this doesn't re-occur. suggest we split into: golden pre-merge, nightly prefix sweep, chaos microdrill. owners?
Abe (eng-ml): i'll take golden + regression pack. plan: 40 prompts drawn from incident repros, 2 goldens for pre-merge. ETA: 7 days.
Rina (eng-platform): platform will add two CI jobs: pre-merge/kv-goldens (fast) and nightly/prefix-sweep (longer). i'll also wire metrics to eval-db. ETA: 10 days.
Lee (sre): i'll own the microdrill/runbook. scope: 20m eviction pressure + pod restart, capture eviction heatmap, define rollback gates. ETA: 12 days.
Abe (eng-ml): for the scorer i'll emit semantic-drift and token-delta; pre-merge only fails on semantic-drift > 0.12.
Rina (eng-platform): sample pre-merge smoke snippet: ```name: pre-merge-kv-goldens on: [pull_request] jobs: smoke: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - run: pytest tests/regressions/test_kv_goldens.py -k golden```
Lee (sre): ops-bot: please create an epic to track these items and assign due dates.
ops-bot: Created epic EPI-3210 "kv-eviction-eval-guards". Subtasks: EPI-3210-1 goldens+pack (Abe) due 1808496000, EPI-3210-2 ci jobs+dashboards (Rina) due 1808560000, EPI-3210-3 chaos microdrill (Lee) due 1808580000. Postmortem linked.
Zoe (eng-oncall): nice. add a recurring monthly check "kv-guard review" to oncall rotation. reconvene in 6 days for status. :thumbsup:
